newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: SKorea '97 oil product demand seen at 764 mln bbls.
newsitem.headline: SKorea '97 oil product demand seen at 764 mln bbls.

text.p: South Korea's oil product demand is expected to rise to 764 million barrels in 1997 from an estimated 721.7 million this year, the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy said on Monday.
The expected 5.9 percent growth compares with a 6.6 percent growth in domestic consumption this year.
The ministry said in a statement the oil refiners were seen increasing the output of domestic petroleum products to 856 million barrels from an estimated 727.5 million in 1996.

Hyundai Oil Refinery Co's new 200,000 barrels-per-day (bpd) crude distillation unit, Yukong Ltd's 200,000 bpd CDU and LG-Caltex Oil Corp's 220,000 bpd CDU, which started operations this year, would help boost output in 1997.
South Korea currently has a refining capacity of 2.44 million bpd.

Oil product exports were seen growing to 214.6 million barrels next year against 161.8 million in 1996, whereas imports were expected to shrink to 191.9 million from 283.4 million on the back of rising domestic production, it said.
"The slowdown in gross domestic product growth and energy conservation policies are expected to slow domestic oil product consumption growth for next year," the statement said.
